newsitem.title: USA: Grand Casinos sees H2 charge.
newsitem.headline: Grand Casinos sees H2 charge.

text.p: Grand Casinos Inc said Tuesday it expects to record a non-cash charge of $0.55 to $0.60 in the second half of fiscal 1996 as a result of operating losses at Stratosphere Corp.
Grand Casinos said the charge is about $0.50 per share higher than originally estimated. Grand Casinos owns about 42 percent of Stratosphere.

The company also said it is comfortable with analysts' expectations of $2.27 per share for fiscal 1997, noting that business at its established casinos in Minnesota, Louisiana, and Mississippi is stable and growing.
